items.summary: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
items.recommend_reason_zh: anthropics/claude-plugins-official 是 Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录高质量插件，方便你按需查找并挑选扩展。
items.recommend_reason_en: anthropics/claude-plugins-official is an official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code plugins, making it worth opening as a starting point when you want plugins that Anthropic itself curates.

items.summary: Ask anything. Then play it, Duolingo-style.
items.recommend_reason_zh: Tomo for ChatGPT 把提问变成 Duolingo 式互动玩法，让你边玩边探索答案，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Tomo for ChatGPT lets you ask anything and then practice it in a Duolingo-style format, making it worth opening for a playful, hands-on way to reinforce what you're learning.

items.summary: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.recommend_reason_zh: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search 是本地 AI 求职框架，评估岗位、定制简历、写求职信、准备面试。
items.recommend_reason_en: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search is a local AI job application framework built on Claude Code that evaluates postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and preps interviews, making it worth opening to fork and own your job search.

items.summary: Krea's AI image model: 2K edits in under 8 seconds
items.recommend_reason_zh: Krea 3 是主打快速编辑的 AI 图像模型，能在 8 秒内完成 2K 编辑，适合想体验高效改图的人。
items.recommend_reason_en: Krea 3 is Krea's AI image model for 2K edits in under eight seconds, worth opening to see how quickly detailed image edits can be made.
